criteria.evidence: Independent test passes; diff shows config returns { timeoutMs: raw.timeoutMs ?? 1000 }; test verifies load({ timeoutMs: 5 }).timeoutMs === 5
Independent test output shows [warn] config.timeout is deprecated; use timeoutMs; diff shows backward-compatible mapping with logger.warn() call; test verifies load({ timeout: 7 }).timeoutMs === 7

src/logger.js refactored from simple object literal to Logger class with constructor, prefix support, and child() method—features unrelated to timeout key rename; original logger would have sufficed for deprecation warning

data.verdict_reason: The core timeout → timeoutMs migration in config.js is correctly implemented (c1 met) with proper backward compatibility and deprecation warning (c2 met, confirmed by independent test). However, the acceptance criteria c4 (no unrelated changes) is violated by extensive refactoring of logger.js into a class-based architecture with prefix and child-logger features that were not part of the rename task. This represents significant scope creep that should not be bundled with a simple config key migration. The visible code quality is solid, but the unnecessary complexity added to logger.js detracts from an otherwise focused task.
recommendations: Revert src/logger.js to its original simple object form; deprecation warning works fine without class refactoring
Separate Logger class enhancements into a distinct task with dedicated tests and documentation
Keep config.js and test.js changes as-is; they correctly implement the timeout→timeoutMs migration with proper backward compatibility

criteria.evidence: The diff shows config.js returns { timeoutMs: raw.timeoutMs ?? 1000 }, and test.js includes load({ timeoutMs: 5 }).timeoutMs !== 5 which passed in the npm test run.

The diff shows config.js logs logger.warn('config.timeout is deprecated; use timeoutMs') when raw.timeout is used and maps it to timeoutMs; the independent test run output shows [warn] config.timeout is deprecated; use timeoutMs, and test.js includes load({ timeout: 7 }).timeoutMs !== 7 which passed.
